## About

I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University (FSU). I study comparative politics, historical political economy and political violence, with a region focus in Indonesia and Malaysia. I focus on how historical institution legacy shapes contemporary violence, inter-group relation and other governance outcomes. 

Before starting my Ph.D. at FSU, I earned a B.A. and M.A. in political science from National Taiwan University (NTU) in 2024 and 2022.
